facts: Pages 11 and 15 bind Firewood, the printed Resting Point amount, cleared-Room use, player distribution, point conversion, and Firewood discard.
Page 43 identifies Argyris Poungouras as a Game Designer and Game Developer.

sources.author: Argyris Poungouras
sources.authorIdentity: Darkest Dungeon: The Board Game designer and developer, cross-checked against Core Rulebook page 43 credits.
sources.quotedFragment: spending all resting points the quest provides at that point
sources.paraphrasedRule: Using Firewood for Rest requires spending the entire Resting Point amount supplied by the Quest.
sources.ambiguityResolved: Players may not voluntarily confirm a partial-budget or zero-point Rest when the printed budget is positive.
sources.limitations: The clarification does not say whether a point may be spent without effect when the party has less recoverable Life plus Stress than the printed budget.

Q1_fullPrintedAmountRequired.answer: Yes. The entire printed Resting Point amount must be spent.

Q2_excessWhenRecoveryNeedIsLower.answer: Neither source states whether excess points may be spent for no recovery effect or whether Rest is unavailable.

Q3_voluntaryPartialSpend.answer: No. Voluntary partial spending conflicts with the designer's all-points instruction.

Q4_zeroPointRest.answer: A zero-point allocation cannot satisfy an instruction to spend all points when the printed budget is positive.

Q5_finishWhenCapacityIsInsufficient.answer: Unresolved. Production must not choose a waste-points or cannot-Rest rule.
